description: Free: runs the checks a paid call runs before payment (name rules, availability, delegation, limits) without creating an invoice, and returns the price. For zone_create and secondary_create of a new zone it answers delegation_missing with the zone's own nameserver pair (expected_ns) and an ns_ticket: set exactly those NS records at the domain's registrar, wait until the registry publishes them, then call again with ns_ticket. This opens a nameserver offer (limited per caller), so it is not read-only.

arguments.description: The arguments you would pass to that tool (payment arguments are ignored).

tool.description: The paid tool you intend to call.
